gold_points: At Jan 29, 2021, exposure was on variable rate cash investments classified as cash equivalents
At Jan 31, 2020, exposure was on variable interest rate debt
Shift driven by $1.5 billion senior unsecured notes issued in Q1 2020 for COVID-19 liquidity
Rate changes on fixed rate debt affect fair value, not pre-tax earnings or cash flows
